create_TimeProfiler_instance: create a TimeProfiler instance with a custom window size to measure frame rates
start_TimeProfiler_timer: start the TimeProfiler timer to begin measuring elapsed time for a frame operation
stop_TimeProfiler_and_get_rates: stop the TimeProfiler timer and get instantaneous, average, and windowed frame rates
reset_TimeProfiler: reset the TimeProfiler to clear all accumulated timing data and frame counts
measure_frame_rate_in_loop: measure frame rates in a loop by calling start and stop on each iteration
